data.content_ref: inline:The extracted_episodes.json (SRC_005) integrates mutations.json (SRC_004) as its perturbation layer: SRC_005 records the run-level episode narrative in which mutation campaigns from SRC_004 are embedded as the experimental interventions whose results the episodes report. Refuted if mutation records in SRC_004 are never referenced, instantiated, or summarised within any episode entry of SRC_005, showing the two are merely parallel artifacts rather than integrated.
